criteria.name: A5-1  participation falls with reachability
criteria.detail: production-layer participation across the grid: rho=0.25: 22.2%, rho=0.5: 26.2%, rho=1.0: 29.6%, rho=2.0: 12.0%, rho=4.0: 1.0%, rho=8.0: 0.1%

criteria.name: A5-2  the threshold sits where the definition puts it
criteria.detail: at rho=0.5: 26.2% against a floor of 50%; at rho=2.0: 12.0% against a ceiling of 5%. rho=1 is where the median agent can just pay, not a fitted value

criteria.name: A5-3  the sign of the production layer's trend flips
criteria.detail: net worth share at rho=0.25: 0.281 -> 0.006; at rho=4.0: 0.281 -> 0.001. One mechanism, two regimes, nothing changed but reachability

criteria.name: A5-4  the benign side is not an equilibrium
criteria.detail: starting at rho=0.5: crossed in 5/5 seeds, median round 1 against 100, 0.0% of subsequent rounds back below one against 5%. Decomposed over the run, the price moves by x40.7 and the median buyer's claims by x0.877: the reachable region closes from the denominator, not only from the price

criteria.name: A5-5  issuance sets the clock
criteria.detail: median crossing round by issuance gain: gain=0.25: 1, gain=0.5: 1, gain=1.0: 1. What evaporates the reachable region is the rate at which new claims arrive at the top

criteria.name: A5-6  freeze the price and the drift disappears
criteria.detail: largest relative move in rho with the price frozen: 304.64% against 1%. Any crossing at a live price is therefore the price channel and not the wage bill, issuance or turnover
